title: frametrail:attributes of type "entity"
description: Linked data entity, such as a Wikidata item: a person, place or concept with its description. Its IRI is the item's frametrail:uri (or the body source). This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "entity". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

embed.description: Whether the entity page may be embedded.

text.description: Description of the entity. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("<p>Hello</p>"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering.
